query:
SELECT ca.customerId, c.fullName, ca.currentBalanceUsd, ca.currentBalanceIqd 
FROM customerAccounts ca 
JOIN customers c ON ca.customerId = c.id 
WHERE CAST(ca.currentBalanceUsd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) > 0 
ORDER BY CAST(ca.currentBalanceUsd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) DESC 
LIMIT 20;
